svg.title: FIG-18 Target RAM maintenance settlement\ Deadline expiry retains protection; permanent busy cannot return
svg.desc: Ordinary provider admission\ Validate input, deadline, layout and actual context; Return rejection\ No retained temporary effects or physical trigger; Enter CPU-only RAM bridge\ Preserve MSP / PSP / CONTROL / PRIMASK; RAM transaction publishes private VTOR\ Prove readback before installing MPU guard; In RAM: scan all 16 RASR.EN\ Save selector and selected descriptor / CTRL; Install and prove Code-domain MPU guard\ XN + Strongly-ordered + AP001; CTRL7; DSB / ISB; Before trigger: prove both banks idle\ Restore every acquired MPU / selector effect; Trigger only the validated physical pulse\ Program stores or erase START; Remain in RAM; retain guard and workspace\ Observe both-bank BSY / QW / WBNE and valid TIM2 epoch; Latch TIMEOUT after trigger\ Do not cancel, clear busy or return; Both banks actually idle\ Prove target LOCK and required barriers; Restore / read back exact MPU state\ Only while Flash is actually idle; Common RAM return gate: every returning path\ Both banks idle; effects zero; exact (saved control | LOCK) proved; RAM transaction restores original VTOR\ Prove exact readback while on private MSP; CPU bridge restores exact caller state\ MSP / PSP / CONTROL / PRIMASK; Return settled result to ordinary code\ IO; else latched TIMEOUT; else SUCCESS; Nonreturning RAM fail-stop\ Retain unproved responsibility; no hidden reset / watchdog feed; invalid; no acquired effects; admitted and command staged; private MSP established; private vector value read back; pre-trigger publication refused; supported disabled MPU; no enabled foreign region; pre-trigger refusal after selector effect; installation and readback proved; installation refused or last pre-issue deadline expired; rollback and idle proved; rejection result; rollback or idle cannot be proved; pulse may be active; latch hardware errors; any busy bit remains; including permanent busy; absolute deadline expires; continue real polling with result latched; epoch lost / exhausted or proof unavailable; all actual busy bits withdrawn; LOCK and valid time-domain observations proved; LOCK cannot be proved; exact guard withdrawal proved; restoration cannot be proved; all return conditions read back; lock idle target if needed; busy, retained effects or exact target LOCK cannot be proved; exact original VTOR read back; VTOR restoration cannot be proved; post-pulse restoration proved; pre-trigger rollback and restoration proved
